description: NOAA NCEI Global Summary of the Month (GSOM, derived from GHCN-Daily): monthly average/maximum/minimum temperature, precipitation, snowfall and heating/cooling degree days for all U.S. stations with data in at least 30 distinct years

source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (Global Summary of the Month v1)
source.license_notes: US federal government work: public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105); no redistribution restriction; cite the publisher. The archive includes non-U.S. stations whose sources may restrict redistribution; only U.S. stations are normalized. Cite Lawrimore et al., NOAA NCEI GSOM.
